review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (DevOps) based in India . As a Senior Software Engineer (DevOps), you will play a key role in designing, implementing, and maintaining secure, scalable, and highly available cloud infrastructure. You will work with modern multi-cloud environments and Kubernetes-based platforms to support advanced enterprise security solutions. Your responsibilities will include infrastructure automation, system optimization, troubleshooting, and continuous improvements to platform reliability and security. Collaborating closely with software developers, architects, product teams, and other engineering specialists, you will help shape technical solutions and influence product development. You will also contribute to strengthening security practices and ensuring infrastructure compliance across complex environments. This is an exciting opportunity to work with cutting-edge cloud and DevOps technologies on products that support digital experiences for billions of users worldwide. Accountabilities Design, deploy, configure, and maintain multi-cloud infrastructure platforms across environments such as Microsoft Azure and Linode. Build, manage, and optimize Kubernetes-based environments, including self-hosted and cloud-native deployments. Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions to automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and management across multiple projects. Implement and maintain automation workflows to improve deployment efficiency, operational consistency, and infrastructure reliability. Troubleshoot and resolve development and production environment issues, identifying root causes and implementing effective solutions. Continuously review and optimize existing infrastructure processes, automation frameworks, and operational workflows. Research, evaluate, and implement technical solutions to strengthen platform security and improve overall infrastructure protection. Apply system updates, security patches, and configuration changes to ensure infrastructure meets relevant compliance and security requirements. Monitor platform performance, availability, and reliability, identifying potential issues and implementing preventive measures. Collaborate with software engineering teams to influence architecture decisions, technical design, and product development. Work closely with Development, Product, Support, and Sales Engineering teams to deliver secure, reliable, and high-quality solutions. Communicate technical implementations, infrastructure changes, and operational improvements clearly across engineering teams and relevant stakeholders. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or an equivalent technical discipline. At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or a related field. Hands-on experience managing cloud infrastructure platforms, particularly AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Linode. Strong practical experience with Kubernetes, including cluster administration, deployment, and orchestration. Experience working with Helm for Kubernetes application packaging and deployment management. Solid knowledge of Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles for automated infrastructure provisioning and management. Experience with monitoring and observability tools, particularly Prometheus, Grafana, and Alertmanager. Proficiency with Git and GitHub for source control, collaboration, and infrastructure or application code management. Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills, with the ability to investigate complex development and production issues. Good understanding of cloud infrastructure security, system patching, compliance requirements, and infrastructure best practices. Experience designing and optimizing automated workflows and infrastructure management processes. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving technical challenges. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams. Ability to take ownership of technical initiatives, work independently, and contribute to architectural and engineering decisions. A continuous improvement mindset and enthusiasm for automation, emerging technologies, and modern DevOps practices. Benefits Remote Working Flexibility: Work remotely from India, with flexibility to work from home, an office, or a combination of both, depending on role requirements. Health & Well-being: Access to benefits designed to support employee health and overall well-being. Financial Benefits: Comprehensive benefits supporting employees' financial security and long-term needs. Work-Life Balance: Workplace flexibility through an adaptable working model. Professional Development: Opportunities to work with advanced cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity solutions, and modern DevOps technologies. Global Collaboration: Work alongside international engineering teams and contribute to technology solutions used by billions of people worldwide. Technical Exposure: Gain hands-on experience with multi-cloud platforms, Kubernetes, Terraform, infrastructure automation, and advanced security solutions. Meaningful Impact: Contribute to improving internet performance, reliability, and security through innovative cloud and edge technologies.
